items.title: 24.4 Evolution from prokaryotes to eukaryotes (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the evolution of eukaryotes (PDF 222).

blocks.text: Zameen ke sab se pehle jandar prokaryotes the jo taqreeban 3.5 billion saal pehle bohat ghair mustahkam mahol mein organic molecules ke reactions se bane. Taqreeban 2 billion saal pehle eukaryotes prokaryotes se bane. Endosymbiotic theory is ki sab se maqbool wazahat hai.

blocks.prompt: Pehle kaun aaye, prokaryotes ya eukaryotes, aur taqreeban kab?
blocks.explanation: Prokaryotes, taqreeban 3.5 billion saal pehle; eukaryotes un se taqreeban 2 billion saal pehle bane.

items: Prokaryotes taqreeban 3.5 billion saal pehle; eukaryotes taqreeban 2 billion saal pehle.
